reason: Most of my business is repeat buyers who call me directly, and my rates move daily and differ by customer, so a quote drafted from a fixed price list would be wrong more often than right. The website part is fine, but I am not paying Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 a month for a quote desk I would end up rewriting every time.
objection: My prices change every day and depend on the customer, so an automatic quote from a price list will be wrong, and who updates it daily? Two hours of changes a month is not going to cover that.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work live on my own enquiries for two weeks, with per-customer pricing and a way for me to update rates from WhatsApp in seconds, so the drafts are actually right.
